blurb: DWMA Ballet Academy is an All Inclusive, Affordable & welcoming Dance Studio. DWMA provides quality dance classes for children in Classical ballet technique, pre- pointe, tap, Musical Theater, contemporary, jazz and hip hop, as well as beginners Acro/gymnastics and cheer. Through our adult program; Chrysalis Yoga & Dance, DWMA offers adult dance, mat & aerial yoga classes.
